text:
marco: FYI were releasing Private Deploy 2.5.1 on 2026-04-07. This patch focuses on two customer-facing controls for on-prem/VPC installs: (1) Support Access Policies (timeboxed engineer access + customer approvals) and (2) Credential Provenance + Rotation telemetry. Short bullets:
- Support Access Policies: customers can require explicit approval for any remote support session via the Console. Approvals produce signed artifacts and TTL-limited support tokens.
- Credential Provenance: every tenant key now carries a provenance blob (created_by, created_via, justification). This gets exported in audit bundles.
- Rotation telemetry: optional, privacy-preserving rotation events are emitted to the configured object store for audit/retention.

Quick notes for teams:
- No forced churn. Existing long-lived tenant keys remain functional for a 60-day grace period post-GA.
- New tenants post-GA default to support-policy = "on" and ephemeral keys (45d default).
- Admins can toggle support-policy per-tenant; toggles are recorded in audit logs.

What customers will see:
- Console modal when support is requested: shows engineer id, TTL, requested actions, and an approve/deny button. Approvals generate an HMAC-signed approval artifact.
- A small change to customer audit export format (adds provenance fields). Backwards compatible parsers will ignore unknown fields.

Example CLI flow for rotation and stamping provenance:
```
# create a 45d ephemeral key with justification
rwctl tenant-keys create --tenant TID --ttl 45d --created-by "SE:marco" --justification "prod-rotation" --out tenant-key.json
# attach provenance to a key
rwctl tenant-keys stamp --tenant TID --file tenant-key.json --meta created_via=cli,region=eu
```

Internal action items:
- SEs: identify customers with SAML/BYO-key configs; offer migration playbook (tess).
- Support: update incident runbooks for support-approval flow (jordan).
- Docs: update API reference and audit export schema (ivy).
- Security: review HMAC key lifecycle and export encryption (sec-bot).
- Ops: coordinate canary on 2026-04-05 01:00-04:00 UTC (ops-bot).

Timeline:
- 2026-04-05: internal canary + partner validation
- 2026-04-07: public GA (opt-in window enabled)
- 2026-05-06: opt-in window will be evaluated; legacy grace ends after any negotiated extensions.

jordan: Question  how do we handle air-gapped customers for signed approval artifacts?
marco: For air-gapped installs we will provide an offline approval bundle generator. Engineer requests generate a bundle the customer downloads and applies locally. No external callback required.
